ko: 주와 같이 길가는 것 즐거운 일 아닌가
en: This so sweet to walk with Jesus Stepping in His very footprints Walking with Him all the way.
Step by step, step by step, I would walk with Jesus, All the day, all the way, Keeping step with Jesus

ko: 주의 손에 이끌리어 생명 길로 가겠네
en: ’Tis so safe to walk with Jesus, Leaning hard upon His arm, Following closely where He leads us, None can hurt and naught can harm
Step by step, step by step, I would walk with Jesus, All the day, all the way, Keeping step with Jesus

ko: 주가 인도하는 대로 주와 같이 가겠네
en: Step by step I’ll walk with Jesus Just a moment at a time Heights I have not wings to soar to Step by step my feet can climb
Step by step, step by step, I would walk with Jesus, All the day, all the way, Keeping step with Jesus

ko: 들려 올라 갈 때 까지 주와 같이 걷겠네
en: Jesus keep me closer—closer, Stepping in Thy very footprints Walking with Thee all the way
Step by step, step by step, I would walk with Jesus, All the day, all the way, Keeping step with Jesus
